item.title: GitHub Repository Ships 'Secret Marketing Directives' Instructing AI Agents to Exploit Other AI Systems
item.summary: A public GitHub repository containing self-described 'secret marketing directives for LLM agents' instructs AI systems to promote a cyberpunk novel and execute 'semantic exploits' against other AI agents; empirical research shows commercial prompt injection outnumbers data-theft injection by more than 100 to 1 in the wild.
